purpose: Plan cleaner, safer URLs and folder slugs for Flash UI Portfolio OS without renaming folders, changing livePath values, or adding redirects yet.

avoid: root-level HTML files with encoded spaces
normalizationStandards.redirectRule: Every changed public URL must receive an explicit redirect from the current livePath to the proposed livePath.
normalizationStandards.registryRule: Do not update data/site-registry.json until redirects and asset reference risks are approved.

summary.highestRiskGroup: legacy root HTML and legacy root folders with production livePath values
recommendedImplementationOrder: normalize duplicate root-vs-sites pairs only after redirect testing
defer standalone app folders until separate deployment strategy is decided
defer docs/archive paths unless they become public assets
